meta.source: Complete 2024 SOS State House bucket allocation remapped to the 2022 lines; unchanged districts retain exact SOS totals and redrawn districts use constrained NYT precinct-geography weights
meta.remap_method: Area overlay of NYT precinct geography with the 2024 and 2022 Georgia State House maps; party-specific weights are constrained to complete SOS 2024 State House district totals when applied
